title: Cisco Webex Room
description: Represents a Webex room (space) where people post messages and collaborate. Rooms can be direct (1:1) or group conversations, and can be organized within teams.

title.description: A user-friendly name for the room.

isPublic.description: Whether the room is public and discoverable within the organization.

isAnnouncementOnly.description: Whether only moderators can post messages.

teamId.description: The team ID associated with the room.

lastActivity.description: Date and time of the last activity in the room.

creatorId.description: The person ID of the room creator.

ownerId.description: The person ID of the room owner.

classificationId.description: The classification ID of the room.

madePublic.description: Date and time the room was made public.

created.description: Date and time the room was created.
